opennyai_summary.20_January_2023__facts:
The petitioners seek bail in connection with Chautham PS Case No 213 of 2022 registered for the offence Patna High Court CR.
There is alleged recovery of illicit liquor from two vehicles.
From the petitioners' vehicle, bearing Registration No.BR-01-FC0987, the alleged quantum of recovery is 36 liters.
Four persons,
including the petitioners, are stated to be in the vehicle.
Petitioners has no concern with the alleged recovery.
Having no antecedents, the petitioners are in custody since 06.08.2022.
opennyai_summary.20_January_2023__decision:
Having regard to the manner of recovery, submissions advanced by the parties, period of custody,
and the fact that investigation is complete, this Court for the purposes of grant of bail is inclined to accept the submissions advanced by Patna High Court CR.
Prayer for bail of the petitioners is allowed.
Let the petitioners, above named, be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the court of Sri Aditya Suman, learned Special Excise Judge- 1st, Khagaria, in connection with Chautham PS Case No 213 of 2022, subject to the following conditions:
(i) That one of the bailors of each of the petitioners will be a close relative of the petitioners who will give an affidavit giving genealogy as to how he is related with the petitioners concerned.
The bailors will also undertake to inform the court if there is any change in the address of the petitioners.
(ii) That the petitioners will be well represented on each date and if they fail to do so on two consecutive dates, their bail bonds will be liable to be cancelled.
